title: Ring
spec: Create a coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw the first arc from coordinates (0.093, 0.2362) to (0.207, 0.2362) with a midpoint at (0.15, 0.0). Next, draw the second arc from (0.207, 0.2363) to (0.207, 0.5137) with a midpoint at (0.3, 0.375). Follow this with the third arc from (0.207, 0.5137) to (0.093, 0.5137) with a midpoint at (0.15, 0.75). Finally, draw the fourth arc from (0.093, 0.5137) to (0.093, 0.2363) with a midpoint at (0.0, 0.375). In the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.15, 0.375) with a radius of 0.11. For the third loop, draw a circle centered at (0.15, 0.125) with a radius of 0.0995. In the fourth loop, draw another circle centered at (0.15, 0.625) with a radius of 0.0995. Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles set to zero and translating it using the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.03 units in the direction of the normal and 0.0 units in the opposite direction to create a new solid body. Name this part "Ring Assembly". The part consists of three concentric rings aligned linearly. The total length of the part is 0.3 units, the width is 0.75 units, and the height is 0.03 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane()

# Create the outer loop of the sketch
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.093, 0.2362).threePointArc((0.15, 0.0), (0.207, 0.2362)) \
               .threePointArc((0.3, 0.375), (0.207, 0.5137)) \
               .threePointArc((0.15, 0.75), (0.093, 0.5137)) \
               .threePointArc((0.0, 0.375), (0.093, 0.2363)) \
               .close()

# Create the inner loops of the sketch
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.15, 0.375).circle(0.11) \
               .moveTo(0.15, 0.125).circle(0.0995) \
               .moveTo(0.15, 0.625).circle(0.0995)

# Extrude the sketch to create the 3D model
r = sketch.extrude(0.03)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Middle ring (larger)
rm_o = 0.15   # outer radius
rm_i = 0.12   # inner radius
rm_y = 0.375  # center position in Y

# Small rings (top and bottom)
rs_o = 0.12   # outer radius
rs_i = 0.09   # inner radius
rc = 0.255    # distance from middle center

# Build the solid
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.15, rm_y).circle(rm_o).extrude(0.03)
    .moveTo(0.15, rm_y).circle(rm_i).extrude(0.03, combine=True)
)

r = (
    r.union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .moveTo(0.15, rm_y + rc).circle(rs_o).extrude(0.03)
        .moveTo(0.15, rm_y + rc).circle(rs_i).extrude(0.03)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .moveTo(0.15, rm_y - rc).circle(rs_o).extrude(0.03)
        .moveTo(0.15, rm_y - rc).circle(rs_i).extrude(0.03)
    )
)

import cadquery as cq

R_out = 0.150
R_in = 0.100
thick = 0.030
centers = [(0.150, 0.150), (0.150, 0.375), (0.150, 0.600)]

outer = cq.Workplane("XY").pushPoints(centers).circle(R_out).extrude(thick)
inner = cq.Workplane("XY").pushPoints(centers).circle(R_in).extrude(thick)

r = outer.cut(inner)
